purpose: Admit a source-free visual recipe for the temporary Threadball cast sequence. WP-015C may later bind this recipe to existing authoritative presentation events; this configuration itself creates no runtime path or product media.

event_binding.authority_rule: The event plan may consume only the already-authoritative actor, Relic id, aim/trace, projectile start/end, and impact point. It must not alter launch origin, collision, damage, crater radius, turn deadline, replay, reward, or server state.

procedural_effects.rendering_rule: These are transient code-drawn graphics admitted for later WP-015C only. They are not raster assets, do not change any approved source file, and must be deterministic from phase progress and authoritative presentation input.

cast_charge.graphic: one restrained gold halo behind the held Loomseed plus at most three short blue thread strokes directed inward

cast_formation.graphic: center the two approved temporary-knot stages at the transformed emission origin; the permanent Loomseed remains visible and stationary

flight_tail.graphic: the compact projectile master at the current trace endpoint with a short taut blue-and-gold tail sampled only from preceding trace segments

impact_unravel.graphic: at most four short blue/gold thread loops that open outward and fade; no explosion, shockwave, fire, or crater outline

allowed: use the three approved static Threadball stages and permanent Loomseed as later client-only presentation inputs
deterministic code-drawn halo, thread strokes, tail, and unravel loops within the listed limits
root-transform the Wizard, Loomseed anchor, emission origin, and temporary cast stages together
add a later client presentation phase before the already-authoritative projectile phase
blocked: randomness not derived from explicit presentation inputs
WP-015C runtime integration in this B3C contract

acceptance.phone_read: The permanent Loomseed remains visibly held while a smaller temporary knot forms and launches; the projectile has no baked or long trail; impact reads as material Unraveling rather than a blast.
acceptance.causal_read: For both player and Loomkeeper, cast charge and formation occur before the existing authoritative projectile trace, and the impact effect occurs only at the existing authoritative impact point.
acceptance.reduced_motion: The same causal phase order remains, with the frozen shortened durations and no continuous decorative loop.
later_verification: unit-test normal and reduced-motion phase order and duration bounds
full phone-browser matrix and canonical visual review after WP-015C integration
real-device review after a runtime path exists
verify no visual parameter reads crater radius, damage, collision, reward, or replay state
